title: Illustrative KV cache growth per request
method: Synthetic architecture:2×32 layers×8 KV heads×128 dimensions×2 bytes=128KiB per token. Multiply by cached tokens and divide by2^20 for MiB. Excludes overhead, cache sharing and architecture-specific variants; no named-model claim.
alt: Illustrative KV cache growth per request. 2,048 cached tokens: 256 MiB, 4,096 cached tokens: 512 MiB, 8,192 cached tokens: 1024 MiB. Illustrative data.
